
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/cyh1130/p/20272686" title="发布于 2026-06-02 17:43">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">十年后回头看，2026 年或许是程序员行业的转折点</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="nice" data-tool="mdnice编辑器" data-website="https://www.mdnice.com" style="margin: 0; padding: 0 10px; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; font-family: PingFangSC-regular, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; word-spacing: 0; letter-spacing: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; text-align: left"><p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">前段时间忙着比赛、课程和项目开发，很久没有更新了。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这段时间里，我体验了不少新的开发工具，一个越来越强烈的感觉不断出现：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">我们或许正在见证程序员行业近十年来最大的变化。</strong></p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">也许很多年后再回头看，2026 年会成为一个特殊的时间节点。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">因为这一年，AI 开始发生质变。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">它不再只是帮程序员补全代码、回答问题，而是开始直接参与软件开发。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">写接口、修 Bug、生成文档、编写测试、提交 PR，甚至同时处理多个开发任务。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">过去是程序员写代码，AI 提建议；</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">现在正逐渐变成程序员提需求，AI 去执行。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">软件开发正在进入一个新的阶段——Agent 时代。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">而看到这些变化的时候，我突然意识到：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">程序员这个职业，可能真的要变了。</strong></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(251, 251, 251, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); line-height: 2.4em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 0 30px 0 15px; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0 0 40px; align-items: unset; box-shadow: none; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">什么是 AI Agent？</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">先说一个很多同学容易混淆的概念。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">我们平时使用 ChatGPT、DeepSeek、Kimi 之类工具，本质上属于对话式 AI。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">你问一句。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">它回答一句。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">你继续追问。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">它继续回答。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">整个过程仍然需要人不断参与。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">而 Agent 不一样。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">Agent 更像一个拥有执行能力的智能员工。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">你只需要告诉它：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">“帮我完成这个任务。”</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">它会自己分析需求。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">自己制定方案。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">自己调用工具。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">自己编写代码。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">自己运行测试。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">最后把结果交给你检查。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">简单来说：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">以前：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">程序员 → 写代码</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">AI → 提建议</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">现在：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">程序员 → 提需求</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">AI → 写代码</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这种变化听起来很小。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但实际上完全改变了开发流程。</p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(251, 251, 251, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); line-height: 2.4em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 0 30px 0 15px; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0 0 40px; align-items: unset; box-shadow: none; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">JetBrains AIR：AI 原生 IDE 的出现</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">今年让我印象最深的产品之一，就是 JetBrains 发布的 AIR。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">JetBrains 是 IntelliJ IDEA、PyCharm、WebStorm 等开发工具的开发公司。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">很多 Java 程序员每天都在使用它们。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">而 AIR 的思路非常激进。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">它不是在 IDE 里面加入 AI。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">而是：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">围绕 AI 重新设计 IDE。</strong></p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">官方甚至提出了一个很有意思的观点：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">过去的 IDE 是把各种工具围绕代码编辑器构建。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">AIR 则是把所有工具围绕 Agent 构建。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这意味着什么？</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">意味着未来开发者的主要工作可能不再是敲代码。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">而是：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">提出需求。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">拆解任务。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">审查结果。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">管理多个 Agent。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">看到这里的时候，我脑海里突然蹦出一句话：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">程序员正在从“工人”变成“项目经理”。</p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(251, 251, 251, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); line-height: 2.4em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 0 30px 0 15px; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0 0 40px; align-items: unset; box-shadow: none; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">OpenAI Codex 的爆发</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">另一个不得不提的产品是 Codex。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">去年很多人还把 Codex 当成一个实验项目。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但今年的发展速度非常惊人。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">OpenAI 官方数据显示，Codex 已经能够在独立环境中完成开发任务，包括：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">编写功能</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">修复缺陷</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">分析代码库</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">编写测试</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">提交代码变更</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">甚至支持多个任务并行执行。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">更夸张的是。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">最近数据显示，Codex 的周活跃用户已经突破 400 万，而且增长最快的群体已经不再是程序员，而是普通知识工作者。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这说明什么？</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">说明 AI 编程已经开始从程序员圈子向整个社会扩散。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">未来很多不会写代码的人，也能够借助 AI 构建自己的应用。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">以前大家说：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">不会编程的人和程序员之间隔着一道墙。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">现在这堵墙正在被 AI 一点点拆掉。</p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(251, 251, 251, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); line-height: 2.4em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 0 30px 0 15px; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0 0 40px; align-items: unset; box-shadow: none; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">作为大三学生，我为什么既兴奋又焦虑？</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">说实话。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">刚开始看到这些消息的时候。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">我是焦虑的。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">因为很多人都在讨论一个问题：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">程序员会不会被 AI 取代？</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">尤其是大学生。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">看到 AI 几分钟完成一个项目。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">看到 Agent 自动修复 Bug。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">看到一句提示词生成完整页面。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">很容易产生一种感觉：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">那我学这些还有意义吗？</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">后来我想明白了一件事。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">AI 淘汰的不是程序员。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">而是不会使用 AI 的程序员。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">就像计算器出现以后。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">数学没有消失。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">Excel 出现以后。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">会计没有消失。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">IDE 出现以后。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">程序员也没有消失。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">工具一直在进步。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但真正有价值的能力始终没有变。</p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(251, 251, 251, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); line-height: 2.4em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 0 30px 0 15px; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0 0 40px; align-items: unset; box-shadow: none; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">未来真正重要的能力是什么？</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">我认为有三点。</p>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 2px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(34, 34, 34, 1); line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 4px 6px 0; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">第一：解决问题的能力</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">AI 可以写代码。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但它不知道你真正想解决什么问题。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">需求分析。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">业务理解。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">架构设计。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这些仍然需要人完成。</p>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 2px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(34, 34, 34, 1); line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 4px 6px 0; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">第二：学习能力</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">未来技术更新速度只会越来越快。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">今天是 Cursor。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">明天是 AIR。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">后天可能又出现新的工具。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果停止学习。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">很快就会被淘汰。</p>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 2px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(34, 34, 34, 1); line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 4px 6px 0; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">第三：驾驭 AI 的能力</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">未来优秀程序员和普通程序员之间的差距。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">可能不再是谁代码写得更快。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">而是谁更会使用 Agent。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">谁能把复杂任务拆解给 AI。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">谁能更高效地审核结果。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">谁能构建自己的 AI 工作流。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这可能会成为新的核心竞争力。</p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(251, 251, 251, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); line-height: 2.4em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 0 30px 0 15px; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0 0 40px; align-items: unset; box-shadow: none; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">我最近的一些感受</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">作为一名大三学生。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这一年我明显感觉到：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">学习方式变了。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">开发方式变了。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">甚至思考问题的方式也变了。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">以前遇到问题：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">百度。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">CSDN。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">翻文档。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">查资料。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">一步一步解决。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">现在很多时候：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">先问 AI。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">再验证。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">再实践。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">效率确实提高了很多。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但与此同时。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">我也发现一个问题。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">越来越多人开始依赖 AI。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">却忽略了底层原理。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">会调用接口。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">不会设计系统。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">会写提示词。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">不会分析问题。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">会让 AI 生成代码。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">却看不懂生成的代码。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这其实是很危险的。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">因为真正的竞争力从来不是工具。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">而是你自己。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">AI 可以帮你跑得更快。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但决定方向的仍然是人。</p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(251, 251, 251, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); line-height: 2.4em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 0 30px 0 15px; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0 0 40px; align-items: unset; box-shadow: none; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">写在最后</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果让我用一句话总结最近 IT 行业最大的变化。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">我会说：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(239, 112, 96, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">软件开发正在从“人写代码”，逐渐演变成“人指挥 AI 写代码”。</strong></p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这可能是未来十年最重要的技术变革之一。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">对于已经工作的程序员来说。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这是一次职业转型。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">对于我们这些还在学校里的学生来说。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这更像是一场重新洗牌的机会。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">时代变了。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">规则也在变。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但机会始终存在。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">未来属于那些愿意学习、愿意拥抱变化的人。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">最后也想和大家聊聊：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果 AI 已经能帮我们完成越来越多的开发工作，</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">那么未来计算机专业学生最应该学习的能力是什么？</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">欢迎在评论区一起讨论。</p>
</section>
